text_block_list.text: La-laaah, la-la-laaah! ♪ Oh!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I decide to go out
shopping. Upon stepping outside, I
run
into Смарт Фалкон.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you going out too? I'm on my way to
get some creative input! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
For how to become the most cute 'n'
sparkly Umadol ever, of course!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The other day, this one super popular idol
said, "I made it to where I
am today thanks
to all the input I got!"
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So I figured I need more input too! So
much that I can't fit any more
into my
head! And just enough that I don't go
crazy!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...This sounds slightly concerning.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I mean, sure—if you're willing! I'll
take all the advice I can
get! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
First, we go to a movie theater to watch a
musical.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sniff... That last scene was wonderful... I didn't think the bartender would be a descendant of the Mozart...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: The songs and choreography were amazing too.

text_block_list.text:
Yep! You can really tell how much
everyone loves their craft! It's a bit

different from Umadol stuff, but I think
performances like these are
special in their
own way! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Next, we head to an amusement park
famous for its parades.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at that mascot character over
there! It's so round, but its
movements are
so sharp!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Whoever they are, they're a total pro.

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! You'd definitely have to practice
every day to move like that!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm gonna practice back handsprings
'til I can do ten in a row in
any outfit!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We hit the streets and soon stumble upon
a freestyle rap battle going
on outside.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a rap battle! This is the first time
I've seen something like this
in real life!
Th-they're really into it!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
This is a clash of two strong personalities,
right? Identity is an
important part of
being an Umadol, but I don't know if I'm
on their
level yet...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: No need to compare yourself to a rapper.

text_block_list.text: But I think it'd be better to have some kind of persona! Wouldn't that be more fun to watch?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I need to develop one interesting enough
to beat those rappers!
Maybe something
edgy!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I feel like we're veering off track here...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As we return to the station, the sound of a
powerful drum fills the air.
I look around,
but there's not a drum to be found—only a
lone,
empty-handed performer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wow! Air drums!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's so cool! The performer's air
drumsticks perfectly match the
music
coming from the speakers!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's like there are real drums there! How do
you move your body so
freely like that?!
All I can do is sing and dance...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... If I practice enough, maybe I can
do that too! Air drums... Air
guitar...
Doesn't matter which!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...She's gotten completely sidetracked.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Night falls, and we arrive at a nearly empty
park. The only sound
around us is the
rustling of leaves in the wind. Well, that,
and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: H-huh?! What's that?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That noise... It sounds like a flute those
wandering monks use!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe that one's just out here
alone, playing by themselves!
Now that's
confidence! Talk about believing in
yourself!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Do you think... I could do the same?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
No, not yet! I'm not even close to their
level! I still have a ways to go
before I can
be a monk, don't I?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон looks my way, her gaze
determined yet strangely hollow.
On her
face is the expression of a lost soul.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wha?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: What is it that you want to be?

text_block_list.text: What I want to be? Isn't it obvious?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...Oh. That's what you mean.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm not trying to become a
monk, a rapper, or an air
drummer.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'm trying to be... an Umadol.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Input is only meant to be food for thought.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for reminding me... I almost lost
sight of what really
matters.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad you came along. I would've
been running around in
circles on my own.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: What inspired you the most today?

text_block_list.text:
Hm... The movie had amazing acting, but
the parade showed off some
incredible
stunts.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The rap battle was intense in a good way,
and the air drums were
crazy impressive.
As for the monk, well... I'm still shocked
we just
randomly ran into one.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But they all shared one thing in
common—they believed in themselves
and
stuck to their own paths! So... Oh!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's it! What I liked the most was the
way they all shined!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Every performer and their audiences had a
sparkle in their eyes! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Well, actually, I don't know if the monk
had a sparkle. I didn't get to
see their
face... But anyway!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Everyone gave everything for their
performances, and it inspired all
the
people watching!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that amazing? It makes me want to
light up the world for other
people too!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: And so, the next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Have you heard of fire
dancing before?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...I admire the desire to learn, but she is
way too easily influenced. I'll
have to keep
an eye on her moving forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
